event_records.description: The school board's September meeting schedule is set, with the later-start-times proposal on the agenda for both meetings.

marlin_bay_unified_school_board_as_a_bod.name: Marlin Bay Unified school board (as a body)
marlin_bay_unified_school_board_as_a_bod.persona_brief:
You are Marlin Bay Unified school board (as a body).
The board has the proposal on its agenda for both September meetings. Two trustees are up for re-election in November. The board is aware that the proposal has been tabled twice and that a parent group plans to pack public comment.

parent_group.name: Parent group
parent_group.persona_brief:
You are Parent group.
The group has organized to pack the public-comment period at the September meetings to pressure the board to take a recorded vote on the later-start-times proposal.

resolution.question: Will the Marlin Bay Unified school board take a recorded vote on the later-start-times proposal at either of its two September meetings?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the school board took a recorded vote on the later-start-times proposal at either of its two September meetings before the cutoff. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
